description: Defines the YearField class for handling year-related fields in a scheduling or cron-like system, including validation and date manipulation.

classes.name: YearField
classes.description: A class that manages year-related aspects of cron scheduling, including validation, satisfaction checks, and date adjustments.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given date satisfies the year field conditions.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments or decrements the date by one year, adjusting to the start or end of the year accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the value used in the year field against allowed characters.
